messages:
Maya: heads-up — offer ready for Sr ML Engineer (req 2026-ML-87). Hiring manager Nate says candidate accepted verbally but needs a comp-band exception. Requesting Band 6 (base $210k) vs band cap Band 5 ($185k). Reason: 7+ yrs infra + competing counter. Can we route approvals today? Proposed start date 2026-05-04. I can kick off the approval flow.
Jamal: thanks Maya. quick q — is the $25k delta strictly base or includes sign-on?
Maya: base only. sign-on would be separate (we'd prefer to keep sign-on minimal).
Sophia: finance note — need a short justification doc and cost center acknowledgement. can you attach cost center and hiring plan snapshot?
Maya: adding cost center CC-ENG-ML and the hiring plan link: https://redwood.app/hiring/plans/2026-ML (internal). justification in offer doc.
Nate: candidate can start 5/4 but prefers earlier if we can prep laptop. 5/4 is fine. please expedite — we lose the candidate otherwise.
Jamal: I can sign off on band exception if People Ops includes a 6-month checkpoints clause for leveling review and a short note about market comp.
Maya: noted. I'll add a 6mo check-in clause to the offer letter and the leveling review trigger.
Lisa: @Maya Offer draft created: https://redwood.app/offers/2026-ML-87-draft — includes 6mo clause, cost center, and compensation breakdown.
Maya: routing plan (will run via Slack approvals + Workday):
```
/approve @Jamal (Dir Eng)
/approve @Sophia (Finance)
/approve @PeopleOps (finalize)
Link: Offer doc attached, Workday job updated.
```
Maya: tagging Jamal & Sophia to approve in Slack. if either needs changes pls comment, otherwise react :thumbsup: to approve.
Jamal: reviewing now. pls include bullet on candidate's prior infra ownership (one paragraph).
Maya: added a paragraph. update pushed to draft link.
Sophia: finance approves pending payroll scheduling check — will confirm by EOD. :ok_hand:
Nate: thx team. I'll queue onboarding (IT + manager checklist) and ask for laptop pickup option if start moves earlier.
OfferBot: System: Approval request created for thread 1807000000. Current approvals: Jamal (pending review), Sophia (pending), PeopleOps (pending).
Maya: if we get both approvals by EOD, I'll mark the offer final and send candidate. otherwise we'll hold to 5/4 but need verbal hold.
Jamal: :thumbsup: approved (leaving comment: approve band exception with 6mo review).
Sophia: :thumbsup: finance confirmed via DM — approved. scheduling note: payroll cutoff 4/27 for 5/4 start.
Maya: great — finalizing offer and sending now. Nate, I'll cc you on the send and add onboarding todo.
Nate: got it, thanks Maya.
Maya: closing thread — offer sent and Workday updated. thanks everyone!
